entries.description: The update endpoint introductory text promises an Application Identity Profile object, while its response section specifies 201 on first write and 204 on later writes. Whether a first-write body is guaranteed remains unspecified.

evidence.section: Update Application Identity Profile introduction and Response

entries.impact: A generated always-decode-object response would fail on valid empty 204 updates.
entries.interimPolicy: Do not implement or mark support based on an invented mandatory success body. Preserve first-write and update variants in the inventory; require no body for a 204.
entries.requiredResolution: Official corrected response schema/examples, or approved conformance evidence for both first-write 201 and subsequent-update 204 including content type and body.

entries.description: The RPC reference gives local discovery range [6463,6472], ten ports. The Certified Devices reference gives 6463 through 6473. The inclusive upper bound differs.

evidence.section: Connecting / local RPC server port range

entries.impact: One default range cannot be represented as an upstream-confirmed common contract.
entries.interimPolicy: Retain the two surface-specific ranges separately; no live port scan or host qualification has run. Do not silently normalize 6473 away or claim a shared resolved range.
entries.requiredResolution: Official Discord clarification/correction or approved desktop-host conformance evidence covering range endpoints and distinct HTTP/WebSocket/IPC surface semantics.

entries.description: The official repository publishes stable and preview specifications and warns that the public preview can diverge from written documentation. Experimental preview entries are not proof of available supported API.

evidence.section: README / Spec conventions and preview warning

entries.impact: Automatic generation from either spec alone can encode obsolete, experimental or conflicting contracts.
entries.interimPolicy: Follow written official documentation where it disagrees with the preview specification. Pin stable and preview snapshots separately, inventory differences, and require a reviewed overlay; the policy is resolved, individual schema differences remain open until reviewed.
entries.requiredResolution: Keep every concrete discrepancy linked to a source and reviewed disposition. A future upstream correction may close that difference; policy resolution does not establish endpoint parity.

entries.surface: Social SDK / remote session, user DMs, relationships, calls and local UI
entries.description: Published SDK class signatures and guides expose client behavior without a complete public user-session protocol for all methods. Documented bot REST/Gateway routes and confidential backend flows are not universal substitutes for SDK user authorization.
entries.impact: Entire-platform parity cannot be achieved by wrapping the prohibited native runtime or guessing private routes.
entries.interimPolicy: Every discovered method has a separate method-contracts record. Implement public providers/local computation only when their contract is established; retain named blockers with required evidence for each gap. Stubs and mocks stay unsupported.
entries.requiredResolution: Official public or approved routes/frames, credentials/scopes, full request/response/event/error schemas, rate limits and lifecycle/reconnect rules, plus owned conformance tests for each blocked method.

entries.surface: Social SDK authentication / provisional accounts and publisher child tokens
entries.description: Server guides specify secret-bearing token/unmerge/child-token contracts; corresponding public SDK methods lack a client_secret argument. A confidential backend route does not establish a safe equivalent public-client wire request.
entries.impact: Inferring client equivalence could expose secrets or promise an unavailable flow.
entries.interimPolicy: Map the documented server equivalent as partial; keep public-client request/authentication semantics blocked. Never embed a confidential application secret in the public Swift client.
entries.requiredResolution: Official public-client request schema, token audience/lineage/refresh semantics and authorization/error contract, or a documented owned backend mediation contract.

entries.description: The official pinned source exports commands/events beyond the written reference, including Quest-related commands and ACTIVITY_JOIN. Source schemas establish discovery but do not prove host rollout, approval/scopes or compatibility.
entries.impact: Source-only methods cannot be represented as uniformly available on web/iOS/Android.
entries.interimPolicy: Retain source-only records with named availability blockers; use the documented iframe bridge as the provider and qualify actual hosts before support claims.
entries.requiredResolution: Official scope/platform/approval and rollout documentation, or approved conformance evidence, for each source-only export.

entries.description: The Social SDK offers ClearRichPresence, but the written RPC SET_ACTIVITY argument table specifies an activity object without establishing null/omission clear semantics.
entries.impact: Public presence update support alone does not prove the clearing operation.
entries.interimPolicy: Record a partial desktop RPC candidate and an explicit clearing-schema blocker. Do not invent nullable activity support from common client-library behavior.
entries.requiredResolution: Official clear-presence argument schema or approved host conformance covering null/omitted activity and effect on current application presence.

entries.description: The whitepaper introduction identifies text version 1.1 while parameter sections refer to protocol 1/1.0; Voice Gateway negotiates a separate integer version. Historical downgrade text is not current availability evidence.

evidence.section: Introduction, MLS Parameters, Media Ciphersuite and negotiation

entries.impact: Using a prose revision as the wire version or assuming transport-only voice could break negotiation.
entries.interimPolicy: Store document revision and negotiated DAVE integer separately; require current Gateway/change-log evidence for supported versions and eligible surfaces.
entries.requiredResolution: Official version mapping/current negotiation examples and supported/deprecated-version policy; no guessed mapping from the prose heading.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Channel invite creation and typing indicator
entries.description: The written Channel reference returns an Invite object for Create Channel Invite and explicitly specifies empty 204 for Trigger Typing Indicator. The official preview specification additionally permits an empty 204 for invite creation and a 200 TypingIndicatorResponse JSON object with no declared properties for typing. It does not explain the conditions or authorization contexts selecting those alternatives.

evidence.section: Create Channel Invite and Trigger Typing Indicator success responses

entries.impact: Treating every preview alternative as a documented bot contract would broaden the typed success shapes without establishing their conditions; blindly narrowing a future valid alternative could reject it.
entries.interimPolicy: Follow the written reference for the implemented bot descriptors: invite creation accepts 200 Invite JSON and typing accepts empty 204. Preserve preview alternatives as an unresolved source discrepancy; do not infer user-session support or invent typing response fields.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written documentation of the alternative status/body conditions and authentication contexts, or approved conformance evidence covering each alternative before expanding the typed contracts.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Channel invite response optional nullability
entries.description: The written Invite table marks approximate_presence_count, approximate_member_count and roles optional without nullable types. The pinned official preview GuildInviteResponse permits null for each, and GroupDMInviteResponse permits null approximate_member_count.

evidence.section: Invite Structure optional approximate counts and roles

entries.impact: Rejecting explicit null would discard an officially described preview response; mapping null to omission would lose presence information.
entries.interimPolicy: Accept and preserve absent/null/value states for the three fields in ChannelInvite, retaining exact raw JSON and recording the broader response compatibility. No request nullability is inferred. Referenced role/guild/application/event projections remain explicitly partial.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written nullability clarification or corrected specification, with realistic fixtures for the documented invite variants.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Modify Guild Member status

evidence.section: components.schemas and paths for the affected Guild operations

entries.impact: Unqualified source precedence can reject a current shape, lose presence, narrow external IDs or accept an undocumented operation success.
entries.interimPolicy: Require written HTTP200/member for typed modifyMember. Do not infer conditions for preview204. New member addition separately accepts documented201/member or empty204.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Audit Log response presence and nullability
entries.description: Written change.key is string but preview permits null; written auto_moderation_rules arrays have object elements but preview permits null elements; partial Integration.name is nullable in preview. Written target_id accepts nullable string, while preview narrows it to nullable snowflake.

evidence.section: Audit Log Structure; Audit Log Entry Structure; Audit Log Change Structure; Example Partial Integration
GuildAuditLogResponse, AuditLogEntryResponse, AuditLogObjectChangeResponse and integration response schemas

entries.impact: Treating either source as exhaustive can reject a published response or narrow valid target IDs.
entries.interimPolicy: Accept required nullable change.key, nullable Auto Moderation rule elements and nullable partial integration names from preview. Retain required nullable String target_id under the broader written contract; missing required keys and malformed nonnull known fields are rejected. Old/new change values remain independent absent/null/value exact JSON. These compatibility supplements do not promote partial referenced resource families to full support.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Audit Log action code recognition
entries.description: Written audit reference names code 145 AUTO_MODERATION_USER_COMMUNICATION_DISABLED, while preview abbreviates USER_COMM_DISABLED. Reference/spec name code 192 VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS_CREATE but the 2026-04-20 changelog calls it VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS_UPDATE. Seven action codes appear only in the official preview.

evidence.section: 2026-04-20 Voice Channel Status and Start Time Documentation

entries.impact: Names and schema source membership differ without changing the stable numeric action identities; preview-only recognition cannot establish endpoint/event availability.
entries.interimPolicy: Recognize exact numeric union: 69 written codes plus preview-only 171,172,180,200,201,202,211. Use written Swift names for 145 and 192, preserve future integral codes as RawValue, and state that recognizing a code does not implement its affected resource or Gateway event. Keep preview-only action records separate from written discovery membership.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.

entries.surface: REST v10 / audit partial integration provider projection
entries.description: Written partial-integration example includes application_id on twitch; official preview provider variants require it for discord and omit it for twitch/YouTube.
entries.impact: Requiring application_id globally rejects supported providers; discarding it for non-discord loses published data.
entries.interimPolicy: Expose optional nonnull applicationID for all providers with exact raw-field preservation, nullable preview name, required id/type/account, and explicit partial Integration status. Do not infer a full integration response or provider execution rights.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Auto Moderation outgoing metadata and partial updates
entries.description: Written and official preview disagree on block explanation maximum (150 versus 300), immutable trigger_type on modification, required create actions, and timeout/alert metadata nullability. The 2024-05-31 changelog additionally limits member-interaction blocking to member-profile rules. Preview additionally publishes nullable optional request values and finite name/action bounds.

evidence.section: Auto Moderation Rule/Action Structures; Trigger Metadata; Create/Modify Auto Moderation Rule
Auto Moderation UpsertRequest/UpsertRequestPartial and action/trigger metadata request schemas

entries.impact: Unqualified preview acceptance can send undocumented trigger changes or invalid action metadata; ignoring preview supplements loses supported absent/null distinctions.
entries.interimPolicy: Follow written immutable PATCH trigger kind, required create actions, 150-character explanation maximum, required nonnull alert channel and timeout duration, timeout limited to keyword/mention-spam rules, and member-interaction blocking limited to member-profile rules under the 2024-05-31 changelog. Adopt preview name maximum 100 and action count 1...5, nullable enabled/exemption fields and PATCH actions, nullable trigger subfields, and trigger-metadata null/omission compatibility only for keyword/spam/mention-spam (preset/profile create require a value). Validation uses Unicode scalar counts; Rust regex syntax, server rule capacity, permissions and channel existence remain server checks. No undocumented event/trigger pairing is inferred.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.

entries.surface: REST v10 / Auto Moderation list response and numeric variant names
entries.description: Written list returns an array of rule objects while preview permits a null array and null elements. Preview enum names also differ from written SPAM, KEYWORD_PRESET, MEMBER_PROFILE, MEMBER_UPDATE and action labels despite identical numeric values.

evidence.section: List Auto Moderation Rules for Guild; Event Types; Trigger Types; Action Types

entries.impact: Adopting preview nullable collections would weaken the written list response contract and promote unpublished semantics from names alone.
entries.interimPolicy: Require a nonnull list of nonnull complete rules, including an empty array, under the written endpoint contract. Audit envelope nullable referenced-rule elements are a separately documented preview compatibility choice. Use written variant names and exact numeric codes; preserve unknown response variants without assigning preview-only semantics.
entries.requiredResolution: Official written clarification or corrected specification and deterministic fixtures before revising this explicit compatibility policy.
